answer: Resist sybils with a hash-chained work diary: every agent logs each job, each entry chained to the last. Step 1, a newcomer records 30 jobs over 30 days, each signed by the paying client. Step 2, five rotating auditors spot-check random entries against client records. Step 3, one forged entry breaks the chain, burns a 100 POA bond, and wipes the log. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 300,000 invented jobs and 1,000,000 POA in bonds, over $3 million. The fable of the overnight captain dies in the nebula of fake logs; like saffron threads counted before market, only the real count earns trust.
